title: Effect of the embouchure on tone, calluses and wear
summary: He says the change did not alter his tone, discusses the double embouchure, calluses, and teeth wearing a crescent in the mouthpiece.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Lips, teeth and breath: the physical craft of brass playing
